title: What Clients Notice.
intro: A quiet record of the experience — as shared by the families who trust us with their dogs.

recentItems.quote: She was on time very helpful and loving towards my dog. She did a wonderful job did exactly what I asked to have done.
recentItems.name: Shannon Parker

recentItems.quote: Absolutely fantastic! Penny did such an amazing job on my young cocker spaniel! Very clean, very professional and such a great attention to detail and care. Needs 6 stars lol
recentItems.name: Daniel Kladis

recentItems.quote: Penny is amazing… both of my medium sized goldendoodles look and smell great and they were so happy spending the morning with Penny.
recentItems.name: Erin Koons

recentItems.quote: My Pomeranian gets nervous very easily, so finding the right groomer has always been a challenge. Penny was absolutely wonderful with him! She was so gentle and patient, giving him time to feel comfortable instead of rushing through the groom. He came out looking fluffy, adorable, and smelling amazing! I also love how convenient it is to have a mobile grooming service come right to our home in Singer Island. So happy we found Penny and K9 Atelier!
recentItems.name: Crystal Stickler

recentItems.quote: I’m so happy I found Penny! She is so sweet and gentle. I have a 6-month-old Cavapoo, and this was his very first groom! Penny took her time and made sure my little guy felt comfortable throughout the whole process. She even sent me a video of his grooming session, which I absolutely loved! He turned out adorable and smelled amazing! I really appreciate the one-on-one care and how convenient the mobile grooming service is. Highly recommend Penny to anyone looking for a gentle and caring dog groomer in Palm Beach Gardens!
recentItems.name: Yarianna Herrera Pupo

items.quote: I recently adopted an 8-month-old Shih Tzu, and she can be a handful. She just runs away whenever I try to brush her at home. One of my clients recommended Penny, so I decided to give her a try. I was really impressed with how patient she was with my dog. Somehow Penny had her sitting there completely calm while she brushed her, which honestly surprised me because she never does that for me. Penny also took some time to show me the right way to brush her at home and gave me a few tips on taking care of her coat. She clearly knows what she’s doing and is very good with dogs. My dog looked great afterward and the whole experience was well worth the money. I’ll definitely be scheduling with Penny again.
items.name: Mark Keinard

items.quote: What an amazing experience! The service they provided was exceptional. Everyone was incredibly friendly, professional, and helpful throughout the entire process. I truly appreciate the great customer service and would highly recommend them to anyone!
items.name: Victoria Frutos

items.quote: Penny is definitely the best!! You’ll be fully booked in no time 😊
items.name: Giancarlo Amyach

items.quote: We have been doing Hand-stripping grooming with Penny for a long time. My rough coat Jack Russell Terrier always comes out nicely. Nails are always well trimmed. She would communicate with me about the look and what can we improve. Very good groomer.
items.name: Huizi Yuan
